title: Lacson lauds police over discreet work in Basilan judge killing probe
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson has lauded the police for their “silent and disciplined” work in making a breakthrough in the investigation into the killing of Basilan Judge Joseph Wee Sit…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson has lauded the police for their “silent and disciplined” work in making a breakthrough in the investigation into the killing of Basilan Judge Joseph Wee Sit in Zamboanga City. “This is how high-profile cases are cracked: silent, precise, disciplined, and with methodical efficiency. No fanfare; just results. Congratulations!” Lacson said in a post on X on Saturday night. Lacson’s remarks came after police filed a murder complaint against three suspects linked to Wee Sit’s fatal shooting before the Zamboanga City Prosecutor’s Office on Saturday.
